tools.name: get_studio
tools.description: Get the public House Duck studio statement, current games, development status, and canonical links.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List recent public development Blog posts in Korean, English, German, or Japanese.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Read the full public text of one House Duck development Blog post and receive its source link.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "house-duck-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_posts, get_post · Public sink: get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_posts, get_post · Public sink: get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
